page_title: AUG 2-1 DOR | Augsburg v Dortmund 26/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+10' Augsburg continue the game with a quickly taken free kick.
90+9' Almugera Kabar (Dortmund) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!

90+8' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Nediljko Labrovic easily catches the ball.
90+6' Yusuf Kabadayi (Augsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90+4' It seemed like Arne Maier (Augsburg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
90+4' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+3' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 4:2.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
90' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nediljko Labrovic intercepts the ball.
90' Dortmund quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
89' A lofted cross from Emre Can (Dortmund) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cole Campbell (Dortmund) replaces Donyell Malen.
87' Tobias Welz shows a yellow card to Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) for a tough tackle.
85' Yusuf Kabadayi (Augsburg) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.
82' Substitution. Frank Onyeka is replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
82' Jess Thorup has decided to substitute Alexis Claude-Maurice and he is replaced by Yusuf Kabadayi (Augsburg).
82' A substitution has been made. Chrislain Matsima goes off and Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) comes on.

80' What a chance that is! Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
78' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
76' The attendance is 30660.
75' Jess Thorup prepares a substitution. Phillip Tietz is replaced by Samuel Essende (Augsburg).
75' Marius Wolf is substituted due to injury. Jess Thorup gives a chance to Henri Koudossou (Augsburg).
74' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
73' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) was probably a bit loose with his words to Tobias Welz, who decides to show him a yellow.
73' PENALTY APPEAL after Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
71' The booking goes to Almugera Kabar (Dortmund).
70' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
70' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
68' Nuri Sahin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Almugera Kabar (Dortmund) replacing Julian Ryerson.
65' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the middle of the goal, but Gregor Kobel is alert and thwarts the effort.
63' It's time for a substitution. Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) comes on in place of Felix Nmecha.
63' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) is adjudged offside.
61' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
59' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
57' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
56' The resulting corner, taken by Julian Brandt (Dortmund), comes to nothing.
56' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Dortmund.

55' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.

53' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
52' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) tries to find Phillip Tietz, but he puts too much power on the pass.

50' 2 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a great shot into the bottom right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Gregor Kobel, so the score changes to 2:1.
48' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) attempts to find Julian Brandt with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
46' Nuri Sahin makes a switch. Pascal Gross is coming on in place of Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) at the start of the second period.
46' The game is over for Waldemar Anton (Dortmund). Emre Can comes on for the second half.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Tobias Welz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' The game is interrupted now, Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
42' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
39' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

39' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the left post and forces a good save out of Nediljko Labrovic. The linesman makes the right call and Dortmund will have a corner.
38' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Tobias Welz blows for a foul.
34' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

34' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
32' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
28' Serhou Guirassy receives a sweet pass inside the box from Julian Brandt (Dortmund), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.

25' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom left corner. Gregor Kobel just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
22' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
20' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) meets a cross inside the box, but Gregor Kobel wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
20' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
19' A quickly taken corner by Augsburg.
19' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Good work from Augsburg as they win a corner.
16' It looks like Marius Wolf (Augsburg) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Welz won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
15' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
12' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) whips the ball into the box and Serhou Guirassy takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
9' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
6' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Donyell Malen (Dortmund) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Serhou Guirassy inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the top left corner. 0:1.
1' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Dortmund will kick the game off.
Tobias Welz got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
